headline: TrendForce: PC DRAM contracts to rise 13-18% QoQ in 4Q26
quote: TrendForce forecasts that PC DRAM contract prices will rise 13–18% QoQ in 4Q26, with increases slowing from the previous quarter.
claim: TrendForce forecasts PC DRAM contract prices rising 13-18% QoQ in 4Q26, slowing from the prior quarter, and client SSD contract prices rising by less than 5% QoQ. Notebook shipments fell 15.8% QoQ in 3Q26 and some PC OEMs are revising memory procurement for 2027.
why_it_matters: RAM for laptops stays expensive but the pace is easing; buying a laptop or an Inspiron RAM upgrade soon will not get cheaper yet.
title: Mounting Finished-Goods Inventories Prompt Some PC OEMs to Adjust Memory Procurement Plans for 2027, Says TrendForce

headline: Judge lets DRAM price-fixing suit against Samsung, SK hynix, Micron proceed
quote: the three companies are given until December 7 to respond to the original complaint
claim: A judge denied the motion to dismiss a DRAM price-fixing suit against Micron, Samsung and SK hynix; the plaintiffs say prices jumped by as much as 500% in one year. The ruling is not a judgment; the companies must respond by December 7 and a case management conference is set for January 2027.
why_it_matters: It will not lower RAM prices soon, but it shows how far memory costs have strained buyers like students upgrading laptops.
title: Judge denies motion to dismiss DRAM price-fixing lawsuit against Micron, Samsung, and SK hynix, finds evidence of DRAM collusion plausible after 500% price surge — says chipmakers acted like ‘hawks flying in formation' | Tom's HardwareTom's Hardware
